lead: `bun nv proofs --id` can report a class card as owed after it has landed.
body: `tools/nv/cmd/proofs.ts` reads the roster from `target/release` before `target/debug`, and the release binary is whatever the last `--record-perf` built, so a card added since then is invisible to it. Check with `target/debug/nvs.exe agent show '<Class>'`; the next `--record-perf` rebuilds the release binary and the owed line goes away.
